payload.ambiguity_rule: If provider data is revised, use the series as retrieved at resolution and record the retrieval timestamp. If VNQ or SPY is unavailable for a session, that session yields no reading rather than a zero. Do NOT substitute a different REIT ETF, a REIT index, or a price-only series for the total-return basis; a substitution changes the instrument and voids comparability with the registered base rate. Note for the resolver: this bar is deliberately extreme and was base-rated after the prediction was written at 1.2 percent of 252 sessions, and it is CREED's committed counter-signal, so a marginal reading must be computed rather than judged.
annulment_rules: Annul only if VNQ or SPY ceases to exist or ceases to be priced before closes_at and no continuous adjusted series covering the interval can be reconstructed for the delisted leg.
Annul only if adjusted daily closes for both tickers across the interval become permanently unavailable from every provider after the registered negative-search procedure.
Do NOT annul because the relative never reaches the bar; that is a NO, and a NO on this question is informative because the question is CREED's own counter-signal.
payload.claim: Between 2026-07-27 and 2026-12-31, the VNQ-versus-SPY trailing three-month relative return, measured on a window ENDING within that interval, reaches minus ten percentage points or worse.
payload.fallback_resolution_source: Any provider of split- and dividend-adjusted daily closes for VNQ and SPY, provided the same provider supplies BOTH series over the whole window and the adjustment basis is total return; the two series must never be sourced from different providers for one reading.
payload.negative_search_procedure: After closes_at, retrieve adjusted daily closes for VNQ and SPY covering 63 sessions before opens_at through closes_at from a single provider. Compute the trailing 63-session total-return relative for EVERY session whose date falls in the interval, not a sample and not only month-ends. Record the full series, its minimum value and the session on which that minimum occurred, the provider, and the retrieval timestamp. A NO requires the computed minimum over all in-interval sessions to be strictly greater than minus 10.0; report that minimum with the NO rather than asserting the bar was never approached.
payload.resolution_condition: Resolves YES if, for at least one trading session whose date falls within opens_at inclusive to closes_at exclusive, the trailing 63-session total-return performance of VNQ minus that of SPY, both measured over the same 63-session window ENDING on that session, is less than or equal to minus 10.0 percentage points. Resolves NO if no session in the interval produces such a reading.
payload.resolution_rule: *** THE WINDOW'S END DATE, NOT ITS START, MUST FALL INSIDE THE INTERVAL. *** The trailing 63-session window ending on a qualifying session may reach back before opens_at; what may NOT qualify is a window that ENDS before opens_at. This matters concretely and is the reason the rule is stated: the condition was satisfied on 2026-06-01, 06-02 and 06-03 (minus 11.68, minus 11.84 and minus 10.51 points), roughly six weeks BEFORE the underlying prediction was made, and those sessions are OUTSIDE the interval and do NOT resolve this question YES. Basis is TOTAL RETURN (dividends reinvested), stated explicitly because the price-only basis differs materially and an undeclared basis positions the bar. Window length is exactly 63 trading sessions. A reading of exactly minus 10.0 qualifies.
resolution_sources: AGENTS/CREED/scripts/s8a_relative.py, which computes the trailing relative on both bases and accepts --end YYYY-MM-DD to re-derive any historical session
